s1.syndrome_frame: a slowly enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule on the upper arm
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
no history of local trauma or insect bite
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
no regional lymphadenopathy
normal laboratory tests
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance
basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis on histological examination

shortlist.label: Pilomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches the clinical presentation of a slowly enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule and is supported by the histological findings of basophilic cells and shadow cells

shortlist.label: Bullous pilomatricoma
shortlist.why_kept: variant of pilomatricoma that can present with a bullous appearance, consistent with the multilocular spaces seen on pathological examination

shortlist.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
shortlist.why_kept: can present as a firm, flesh-colored to red nodule, but less likely given the specific histological features of basophilic cells and shadow cells

shortlist.label: Dermatofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: can present as a firm, hard nodule, but typically lacks the distinctive histological features seen in this case

shortlist.label: Keratoacanthoma
shortlist.why_kept: can present as a rapidly growing, firm nodule, but usually has a more characteristic central crater-like appearance and different histological features

raw.rationale: The presence of basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis, along with a solid tumor in the deep dermis having a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance, are characteristic features of pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Bullous pilomatricoma
rejected.why: While similar to pilomatricoma, bullous pilomatricoma is less common and typically presents with bullae, which are not mentioned in the case description.

rejected.label: Epidermal inclusion cyst
rejected.why: Epidermal inclusion cysts typically present as smooth, firm, and mobile nodules, and do not usually have the complex multilocular spaces or the specific histological features seen in this case.

rejected.label: Dermatofibroma
rejected.why: Dermatofibromas are usually smaller, firmer, and more pigmented than the lesion described, and they lack the distinctive histological features of pilomatricoma.

rejected.label: Keratoacanthoma
rejected.why: Keratoacanthoma typically presents as a rapidly growing, dome-shaped nodule with a central crater, which does not match the description provided in the case.
